Multiple postgraduate entrance exam notifications and results released

National bodies have released notifications and admit cards for postgraduate entrance examinations. These include NEET PG 2026, with registration commencing for a test scheduled on August 30th. Additionally, admit cards for ICAR AIEEA PG 2026 and results for AP EAPCET 2026 have been made available, with details on downloading rank cards and counseling updates provided.
